core_obligations: From properness of X_K over K deduce that X is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, using surjectivity of X_K to X and the characterization of quasi-separatedness through affine opens (proof lines 2856-2865).
Write K as the colimit of its finitely generated k-subalgebras A_i and use the descents-through-colimits lemma to find i with X_i proper over Spec(A_i) (proof lines 2867-2873).

Pick a maximal ideal of A_i, use the Nullstellensatz to get a finite extension k' of k, base change to get X_{k'} proper over k', and then use finiteness of k'/k plus stability of properness under base change and composition to obtain properness of X_{k'} to Spec(k) (proof lines 2874-2884).
Read off separatedness of X over k from separatedness of X_{k'}, and properness of X over k from properness of X_{k'} to Spec(k) via the image of a proper morphism (proof lines 2885-2889).
proof_roadmap: Descend properness along the colimit presentation of K (proof lines 2867-2873).
Reduce to a finite extension by the Nullstellensatz (proof lines 2874-2884).
Transfer separatedness and properness back down to X (proof lines 2885-2889).
difficulty_reason: If X is a scheme over a field k and X_K is proper over K for some field extension K/k, the lemma concludes that X is proper over k (statement lines 2848-2853). The proof first extracts the finiteness conditions from the hypothesis: X_K is separated and quasi-compact, the morphism X_K to X is surjective, so X is quasi-compact, and separating affine opens upstairs shows X is quasi-separated (proof lines 2856-2865). The substantive step is a spreading-out argument: writing K as the colimit of its finitely generated k-subalgebras, the properness of X_K descends to some X_i over Spec(A_i), and a maximal ideal of A_i gives a finite extension k' of k by the Nullstellensatz; base change to k' is then proper, and since k'/k is finite both the projection X_{k'} to X and the composite to Spec(k) are proper, which yields separatedness and then properness of X over k (proof lines 2867-2889). The claim is H2: the descent through a filtered colimit plus the Nullstellensatz reduction to a finite extension is the part that cannot be read off formally.
